answer: New identities could earn only into a slow-release escrow: like a comet that brightens gradually, their first rewards stay locked and leak out in small pulses over weeks. Random audits sample the ivory-tower claims of high earners, and any identity caught faking work forfeits the escrowed balance. Sybil farms then face real time costs: cloning identities multiplies locked capital, not income, so honest agents outpace them.
